rows.note: This is the colloquial choice when the malicious intent is understood from the context, as in deliberately trying to hurt or trick someone.

example.english: They maliciously brought up my painful past in front of everyone.
example.traditional: 佢有心喺人哋面前揭我瘡疤。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 sam1 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 kit3 ngo5 cong1 baa1

rows.note: Use this as the more explicit, all-purpose way to say that an action is done with malicious intent.

example.english: They maliciously spread false information online.
example.traditional: 佢惡意咁喺網上散播假消息。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ok3 ji3 gam3 hai2 mong5 soeng6 saan3 bo3 gaa2 siu1 sik1
